objective: Implement HealthSummaryBar, CycleEventCard, and EventDetailDrawer UI components for event logs with 100% test coverage and CI compliance.

acceptance.criterion: HealthSummaryBar displays health summary statistics, search input, and view mode toggle (important vs all_technical).
CycleEventCard renders a chained sequence of cycle events ordered by timestamp and fires onOpenDetail when clicking a step.
EventDetailDrawer renders user-friendly event summary at top and collapsable raw JSON accordion at bottom.
